definitions.full: H6787. Tsemarayim צְמָרַיִם proper name, of a location 1. in Benjamin Josh 18:22 , Σαρα , A Σεμριμ , ᵐ5 L Σαμαρειμ , perhaps Es-samra , north of Jericho Buhl Geogr. 180. 2 ׳הַרצֿ mountain in Ephraim 2Chr 13:4 , Σομορων , unknown.
